title: 师医生
slug: 女为悦己者全本免费-女为悦己者最新章节列表
content_zh:
师医生来了。
太阳从十六院上空升起，师医生就是照进窗户的第一束光。
这形容词并非夸张，师医生经过走廊的时候，清晨的第一束阳光正好射在他身上，他的西装在阳光中闪闪发亮，师医生至少有一米八五，身材瘦削健美，没有一丝多余的赘肉，而他的长相只有比身材更好。
“师医生！”
“师医生早上好。”
一屋子的莺莺燕燕一下都活跃起来，空气中弥漫着说不出的气氛，来自女人的眼神织成一张网，在空气中纵横交错，落到他俊美的容颜，合体低调的西装剪裁，看不到LOGO，但一望即知做工精良的鞋履，以及手腕上无意露出的腕表表面，西装领口那暗色带了点反光的领带夹上。
师医生安之若素，黑发滑落几缕在额前，不经意地带出几分典雅，手表在走动间看得更清楚，是梵克雅宝的情人桥。他的领带夹是低调的暗色金属，只在头部镶嵌一枚红宝石……女人关注的所有重点，他都经得起最严苛的考验，在十九层，美貌是最不稀缺的资源，但他的长相居然能比所有这些精心打造出的美女都更上一层楼。师医生的穿着和一般医生的风格不符，也和跟在他身后走进来的同事格格不入，但你不会觉得怪异，恰恰相反，反而会很心悦诚服：长得和他一样好看的人，自然要穿一些好衣服，没有他这张脸，也配不上这样的华服。
“张主任，今天到得早啊。”向师医生打招呼，没得到回应，居然也没人生气，各自转移目标，向自己的医生讲话。能在十九层挂到号的几乎都是老客户，自然都熟悉。这帮女人对别人说话，眼睛都还是看着师医生——自己打招呼不理会，主治医生帮着介绍一下呢？
“刘老师。”
“沈叔叔——”
“今朝又要来麻烦你了——我挂了第二个号，侬动作快点啊张叔叔。”
“要得，要得。”张主任笑呵呵地说，像是没懂眼神里的暗示，“不过今天怕是要等一会喽——新人到了，要开个小会的，别心急，别心急哈。”
“老师好。”
“老师。”
新人们也早站起来了，纷纷打招呼，“张主任、刘老师，师老师——”
张主任脾气好，脸上一直都带着笑，丝毫不介意自己的风头被师医生抢光。“还叫老师？以后，要叫师主任喽。”
师医生已经聘上副主任医师了？
在职场，称谓必须讲究，主治医师叫老师，副主任医师和主任医师，为了好听当面都是叫主任的。他们来考试的时候，师医生还是主治医师，这当然很正常，在这个年纪能评上副主任医师这才是不正常。
副主任医师，听起来好像是芝麻绿豆，但已经是副高级待遇了，在医院一般都能做到科室主任。要再往上晋升主任医师，那就不是一般人能办到的事了，对于正常的医生来说，能在副主任医师的位置上退休，不大不小也算个人生赢家。很多医生一辈子也就是个主治，就算挣扎到副主任医师，那也至少是40、50岁的事了，而师医生——
师医生今年才33岁吧！

做医生和升官不一样，职业年限有硬性要求，8年本博+5年主治，最理想的状态也要13年，但又有多少人能每一步都无缝衔接？要升副主任，SCI论文和省级课题，这都是必不可少的要件，符合条件更不代表能评选成功，毕竟名额有限、僧多粥少，很多事不用点太明，大家心里都能明白。33岁能评上副主任医师，师医生除了业务以外，一定还有更多的优势。戴韶华指明了要当他的助理，看来事前也是受过高人点拨。
几个新人没什么好妒忌师医生的，他们更在意同侪的背景——竞争关系一样是一句话就能说明白，僧多粥少，十六院出众的人才太多，往上评职称的路，除了本身的业务能力以外，更有许多盘外因素。有时候这步路，你先走一步，那处处就都能快人一筹。大家的眼神都落在戴韶华身上，若有若无地盘旋，不过这个劳力士女孩现在乖得和鹌鹑一样，双手交握身前，唇边含笑，很显然，她也知道该怎么给长辈留下好印象。
“师主任。”
“师主任。”
众人顿时就都改了口，几个主治医师也笑呵呵恭喜，“以后要叫主任了。”

content_en:
The doctor is here.
The sun rises over the Sixteenth Courtyard, and Doctor Shi is the first ray of light that shines through the window.
This adjective is not an exaggeration. When Dr. Shi passed through the corridor, the first ray of sunlight in the morning hit him. His suit shone in the sunlight. Dr. Shi was at least 1.85 meters tall and had a slim and muscular body without any extra fat. His appearance was only better than his figure.
"Doctor Shi!"
"Good morning, doctor Shi."
The whole room suddenly became alive, and the air was filled with an indescribable atmosphere. The women's eyes woven a web, criss-crossing the air, and fell on his handsome face, low-key suit tailoring, no logo, but well-made shoes that could be seen at a glance, as well as the surface of the watch accidentally exposed on the wrist, and the dark and reflective tie clip on the collar of the suit.
The doctor is calm and composed, with a few strands of black hair falling on his forehead, inadvertently giving off a bit of elegance. The watch can be seen more clearly as he moves around. It is Van Cleef & Arpels' lover's bridge. His tie clip is made of low-key dark metal, with only one ruby ​​inlaid on the head... He can withstand the most severe test of all women's concerns. On the 19th floor, beauty is the least scarce resource, but his appearance can actually be a step above all these carefully crafted beauties. Dr. Shi's dress is inconsistent with the style of ordinary doctors, and it is also incompatible with the colleagues who walked in behind him, but you will not find it weird, on the contrary, you will be convinced: a person who looks as good-looking as him naturally needs to wear some good clothes. Without his face, he would not be worthy of such gorgeous clothes.
"Director Zhang, you arrived early today." He greeted Dr. Xiangshi, but received no response, and no one was actually angry. They changed their targets and addressed their own doctors. Almost all the people who can register on the 19th floor are old customers, so they are naturally familiar with them. When these women talk to others, they still look at the doctor - they ignore the greetings themselves, and the attending doctor helps introduce them?
"Teacher Liu."
"Uncle Shen——"
"I'm going to trouble you again today - I called up the second number, so hurry up, Uncle Zhang."
"Yes, yes." Director Zhang said with a smile, as if he didn't understand the hint in his eyes, "But I'm afraid I have to wait for a while today - the newcomers have arrived, and there will be a small meeting. Don't be impatient, don't be impatient."
"Hello, teacher."
"Teacher."
The newcomers also stood up early and greeted each other, "Director Zhang, Teacher Liu, Teacher Shi——"
Director Zhang has a good temper and always has a smile on his face. He doesn't mind at all that his limelight is being stolen by Dr. Shi. "You still call me teacher? From now on, I will call you teacher-in-charge."
The doctor has hired a deputy chief physician?
In the workplace, titles must be particular. The attending physician is called teacher, while the deputy chief physician and chief physician are called director in person for the sake of being nice. When they came for the exam, the division doctor was still the chief physician, which was of course normal. It was abnormal to be rated as deputy chief physician at this age.
The deputy chief physician sounds like sesame and mung bean, but it is already a deputy senior position. In the hospital, he can usually be the director of the department. To be promoted to chief physician is not something that ordinary people can do. For a normal doctor, being able to retire as deputy chief physician is considered a winner in life, no matter how big or small. Many doctors are just attending physicians throughout their lives. Even if they struggle to become deputy chief physician, they will be at least 40 or 50 years old. And the doctor doctor——
Doctor Shi is only 33 years old this year!
Being a doctor is different from being promoted. There are strict requirements for career length, 8 years of master's degree + 5 years of attending the doctorate. The ideal situation is 13 years, but how many people can seamlessly connect every step? To be promoted to deputy director, SCI papers and provincial-level projects are all indispensable requirements. Meeting the conditions does not mean that you will be successful in the selection., after all, the number of places is limited and there are many monks and few people. Many things do not need to be explained clearly, everyone can understand them in their hearts. Being able to be promoted to deputy chief physician at the age of 33 means that a doctor must have more advantages besides professional work. Dai Shaohua specified that he wanted to be his assistant, and it seemed that he had received guidance from an expert beforehand.
There is nothing for the newcomers to be jealous of the doctor. They care more about the background of their peers - the competitive relationship can be explained in one sentence. There are too many monks and too many outstanding talents in the Sixth Hospital. In addition to their own professional abilities, there are many factors outside the market when evaluating professional titles. Sometimes, if you take the first step on this road, you will be faster than others. Everyone's eyes fell on Dai Shaohua, hovering vaguely, but this Rolex girl was as good as a quail now, with her hands clasped in front of her and a smile on her lips. It was obvious that she also knew how to leave a good impression on her elders.
"Director."
"Director."
Everyone immediately changed their minds, and several attending doctors also smiled and congratulated, "I will call the director from now on."
